desc: Ideation: valid subsequences have outer middle-value count >=2, or exactly 1 with the three non-middle values pairwise distinct.

Implement and verify the O(n^2) solution: for each middle index k with at least two indices on both sides, let m=nums[k], a,b be counts of m on left/right, A,B be frequency dicts of non-m values on left/right. Add all choices with at least two outer m via sum_{x+y>=2} C(a,x)C(A,2-x)C(b,y)C(B,2-y). For exactly one outer m, add a*S(A,B)+b*S(B,A), where S(X,Y)=|X|*distinct_pairs(Y)-sum_v X_v*Y_v*(|Y|-Y_v) and distinct_pairs(Y)=C(|Y|,2)-sum_v C(Y_v,2). Apply modulo 1e9+7, then run the provided examples, edge cases (all equal, all distinct, length 5, negatives), and a brute-force checker on small random arrays.
